summary.goal: Replace top-nav with Linear-style left sidebar that's collapsible on desktop and slide-out on mobile
summary.context: Current Layout.tsx uses horizontal top nav. Need vertical left sidebar with: workspace header (logo/name), quick actions (+New, Cmd+K), global nav (Inbox, My Plans, All Plans, Roadmap), initiatives section with collapsible list showing nested plans.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sidebar is 240px wide when expanded, 64px when collapsed (icon-only)
Collapse toggle button persists state to localStorage
On mobile (<768px), sidebar is hidden by default, slides in from left on hamburger click
Workspace header shows app logo and workspace name
Quick actions: New Plan button, Search button (opens Cmd+K palette)
Global nav items: All Plans, Initiatives, Pipeline - each links to respective view (Inbox deferred to v2)
Initiatives section header with 'New Initiative' action
Each initiative row is collapsible, shows icon/color, name, plan count
Expanded initiative shows nested plan links (title, status badge)
Active route is highlighted in sidebar
Hover states and transitions follow design system (accent-cyan highlights)
Content area fills remaining width, scrolls independently

design_spec.approach: Use shadcn/ui Sidebar component as foundation, themed to Mission Control

views.name: Sidebar Expanded
views.layout: fixed left, 240px width, full height, bg-bg-secondary

elements.props: icon, color dot, name, plan count badge

views.name: Sidebar Collapsed
views.notes: Icons only, tooltips on hover, initiatives section hidden

views.name: Sidebar Mobile Drawer
views.layout: offcanvas from left, full expanded width, overlay backdrop

custom_needed: InitiativeCollapsible - SidebarMenuItem with Collapsible, shows icon/color/name/count, expands to show plan links
PlanSubItem - SidebarMenuSubItem with status dot indicator (draft=muted, approved=cyan, published=green)

steps.title: Install shadcn/ui sidebar dependencies
steps.description: Install required shadcn/ui primitives for sidebar: @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-collapsible, @radix-ui/react-tooltip, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge. Add shadcn cn() utility function.

acceptance_criteria.description: @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-collapsible, @radix-ui/react-tooltip installed in package.json
class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge installed
src/lib/utils.ts exports cn() function using clsx + tailwind-merge

steps.title: Add shadcn/ui Sidebar component files
steps.description: Create src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx with all sidebar primitives from shadcn/ui (SidebarProvider, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubItem, SidebarTrigger, useSidebar hook). Theme CSS variables to Mission Control colors.

acceptance_criteria.description: sidebar.tsx exports all listed components
useSidebar hook provides { state, open, setOpen, toggleSidebar, isMobile }
SidebarProvider accepts collapsible='icon' mode
CSS variables use --bg-secondary, --border-subtle, --bg-tertiary from design system
Sidebar width: 240px expanded, 64px collapsed (icon mode)

steps.title: Add Tooltip component for collapsed state
steps.description: Create src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx using @radix-ui/react-tooltip. Tooltip needed for icon-only collapsed sidebar to show labels on hover.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider exported
Tooltip styled with bg-bg-elevated, text-text-primary, rounded-md
Tooltip appears on hover with 200ms delay

steps.title: Add initiatives API client functions
steps.description: Add API client functions to src/api/index.ts for initiatives: listInitiatives(), getInitiative(id). These consume the backend endpoints from schema-org-initiative feature.

acceptance_criteria.description: listInitiatives() returns Promise<{ initiatives: Initiative[] }> where Initiative = { initiative_id, org_id, name, description, status, icon, color, plan_count }
getInitiative(id) returns Promise<{ initiative: Initiative & { plans: PlanSummary[] } }>
Initiative TypeScript interface added to src/types.ts

steps.title: Create useInitiatives hook
steps.description: Create src/hooks/useInitiatives.ts that fetches initiatives list and provides loading/error states. Cache results to avoid refetching on navigation.

acceptance_criteria.description: useInitiatives() returns { initiatives, isLoading, error, refetch }
Initiatives cached in state, refetch on mount if stale (>30s)
Hook exported from src/hooks/index.ts

steps.title: Create useSidebarState hook for persistence
steps.description: Create src/hooks/useSidebarState.ts that persists collapsed/expanded state to localStorage. Syncs with SidebarProvider state.

acceptance_criteria.description: useSidebarState() returns { isCollapsed, setCollapsed }
State persisted to localStorage key 'sidebar-collapsed'
Initial state read from localStorage on mount
Hook exported from src/hooks/index.ts

steps.title: Create AppSidebar component
steps.description: Create src/components/AppSidebar.tsx as the main sidebar component. Compose shadcn/ui sidebar primitives with: Header (logo + collapse toggle), Quick Actions (New Plan + Search), Navigation (All Plans, Initiatives, Pipeline), Initiatives list (collapsible per initiative).

acceptance_criteria.description: AppSidebar renders SidebarHeader with diamond logo + 'Planner' text + collapse toggle
Quick Actions group has New Plan button (links to /plans/new) and Search button (opens command palette via useCommandPalette)
Navigation group has All Plans (/plans), Initiatives (/initiatives), Pipeline (/pipeline) links
Initiatives section header shows 'INITIATIVES' label + Plus icon button
Each initiative rendered with InitiativeCollapsible (step i008)

steps.title: Create InitiativeCollapsible component
steps.description: Create src/components/InitiativeCollapsible.tsx - a SidebarMenuItem with Collapsible behavior. Shows initiative icon/color dot, name, plan count badge. When expanded, shows nested plan links using SidebarMenuSub.

acceptance_criteria.description: InitiativeCollapsible accepts { initiative, plans } props
Collapsed state shows: color dot (initiative.color), name, plan count badge
Expand/collapse chevron animates on toggle
Expanded state shows SidebarMenuSub with plan links
Each plan link shows title + status dot (draft=text-muted, approved=accent-cyan, published=accent-green)

steps.title: Add sidebar CSS variables to globals.css
steps.description: Add sidebar-specific CSS variables to globals.css: --sidebar-width, --sidebar-width-collapsed, --sidebar-bg, --sidebar-border, --sidebar-item-hover, --sidebar-item-active.

acceptance_criteria.description: --sidebar-width: 240px
--sidebar-width-collapsed: 64px
--sidebar-bg: var(--bg-secondary)
--sidebar-border: var(--border-subtle)
--sidebar-item-hover: var(--bg-tertiary)
--sidebar-item-active: rgba(0, 217, 255, 0.1)

steps.title: Refactor Layout.tsx to use sidebar
steps.description: Replace current top-nav Layout.tsx with sidebar layout. Wrap with SidebarProvider, render AppSidebar on left, main content fills remaining width. Remove old header navigation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Layout wrapped in SidebarProvider with collapsible='icon' and defaultOpen from useSidebarState
AppSidebar rendered on left side
Main content area uses flex-1, scrolls independently
Old header nav removed (no more top navigation bar)
CommandPalette still mounted and functional

steps.title: Add mobile sidebar behavior
steps.description: Add mobile-specific sidebar behavior: hidden by default on <768px, hamburger menu button in mobile header triggers slide-in drawer with backdrop overlay.

acceptance_criteria.description: On viewport <768px, sidebar hidden by default
MobileHeader component shows hamburger menu button + app logo
Hamburger click opens sidebar as full-height drawer from left
Backdrop overlay closes sidebar on click
Navigation in mobile sidebar closes drawer after selection

steps.title: Add active route highlighting
steps.description: Highlight active route in sidebar navigation using useLocation. Apply active styles per design_spec: bg-accent-cyan/10, text-accent-cyan, border-l-2 border-accent-cyan.

acceptance_criteria.description: Current route highlighted with isActive prop on SidebarMenuButton
Active style: bg-accent-cyan/10 text-accent-cyan border-l-2 border-accent-cyan
Nested plan links highlight when on /plans/:id route matching that plan
Parent initiative row shows partial highlight when child plan is active

steps.title: Add New Initiative action
steps.description: Wire up the Plus button in Initiatives section header to create new initiative. For v1, navigate to /initiatives/new or open a modal (defer full modal to ui-initiatives-view).

acceptance_criteria.description: Plus button in Initiatives header navigates to /initiatives/new
Button has tooltip 'New Initiative' in collapsed mode
Button styled consistently with other sidebar actions

steps.title: Add keyboard navigation support
steps.description: Ensure sidebar supports keyboard navigation: Tab focuses items, Enter activates, Escape closes mobile drawer, Arrow keys navigate within menus.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tab key moves focus through sidebar items
Enter key activates focused item (navigation or expand/collapse)
Escape key closes mobile sidebar drawer
Arrow Up/Down navigate within menu groups
Focus indicators visible (outline-accent-cyan)

steps.title: Add icons for new navigation items
steps.description: Add missing icons to src/components/icons/index.tsx: TargetIcon (initiatives), GitBranchIcon (pipeline), ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon, MenuIcon (hamburger), DiamondIcon (logo).

acceptance_criteria.description: TargetIcon exported (for Initiatives nav item)
GitBranchIcon exported (for Pipeline nav item)
ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon exported (for collapse toggle)
MenuIcon exported (hamburger for mobile)
DiamondIcon exported (for app logo)
All icons follow existing pattern: stroke-based, currentColor, configurable size

steps.title: Write tests for sidebar components
steps.description: Add tests for AppSidebar, InitiativeCollapsible, useSidebarState, useInitiatives. Cover: rendering, collapse/expand, localStorage persistence, navigation.

acceptance_criteria.description: AppSidebar.test.tsx: renders all sections, collapse toggle works
InitiativeCollapsible.test.tsx: expands to show plans, collapse hides them
useSidebarState.test.ts: persists to localStorage, reads initial state
useInitiatives.test.ts: fetches initiatives, handles loading/error
All tests pass: npm run test
